sources.title: A high-performance speech neuroprosthesis
sources.observed_result: Attempted speech was decoded to text from intracortical spiking activity in a participant with paralysis.

sources.title: A high-performance neuroprosthesis for speech decoding and avatar control
sources.observed_result: High-density cortical recordings supported real-time text, speech-audio and avatar outputs during attempted silent speech.

sources.title: Representation of internal speech by single neurons in human supramarginal gyrus
sources.observed_result: Internal and vocalized words showed decodable neural representations in implanted participants for a bounded vocabulary/task.

sources.title: A neural speech decoding framework leveraging deep learning and speech synthesis
sources.observed_result: A deep-learning ECoG decoder mapped cortical signals into speech parameters and synthesized speech across a cohort of 48 participants.

sources.title: Decoding speech perception from non-invasive brain recordings
sources.observed_result: Non-invasive recordings supported model-based decoding of perceived speech above baselines across participants.

sources.title: Semantic reconstruction of continuous language from non-invasive brain recordings
sources.observed_result: Continuous-language meaning was reconstructed from fMRI using an encoding model and language-model-assisted candidate search.

sources.title: Decoding motor plans using a closed-loop ultrasonic brain–machine interface
sources.observed_result: Functional ultrasound was used in a closed-loop BMI to decode motor plans, demonstrating an ultrasonic neural READ pathway.

sources.title: Transcranial focused ultrasound to V5 enhances human visual motion brain-computer interface by modulating feature-based attention
sources.observed_result: Targeted transcranial focused ultrasound modulated a human BCI task when applied to visual area V5.

sources.title: Power-saving design opportunities for wireless intracortical brain–computer interfaces
sources.observed_result: Experimental iBCI data were used to quantify signal-quality, decoder-performance and power trade-offs relevant to wireless implants.

sources.title: Endocisternal interfaces for minimally invasive neural stimulation and recording of the brain and spinal cord
sources.observed_result: A wireless endocisternal interface demonstrated recording and stimulation functions in sheep with repositioning and chronic implantation.

sources.title: Long-term independent use of an intracortical brain–computer interface for speech and cursor control
sources.observed_result: A participant used an intracortical BCI independently and near-daily for speech and cursor control over an extended period; the published setup used percutaneous wired connections.

sources.title: A neuroprosthesis for restoring hand movement and sensation in a person with complete tetraplegia
sources.observed_result: A double neural bypass linked intracortical decoding with patterned spinal and cortical stimulation to restore movement and sensation in a participant with tetraplegia.

sources.title: Towards decoding individual words from non-invasive brain recordings
sources.observed_result: A multi-dataset pipeline evaluated individual-word decoding from EEG and MEG across hundreds of participants and multiple languages/tasks.

sources.title: An open-access EEG dataset for speech decoding: Exploring the role of articulation and coarticulation
sources.observed_result: Open EEG datasets provide phoneme, articulation and word-level speech tasks suitable for reproducible decoder benchmarking.
